changes.label: Score inquiries
changes.public_note: Contact [Elkin Music](https://www.elkinmusic.com/contact-us) for score inquiries about the alto saxophone and piano edition of *Pathetic Story*, Millstone **MP0261**.

changes.label: Score inquiries
changes.public_note: Contact [Groth Music / Dorn Publications](https://www.grothmusic.com/t-contact.aspx) for score inquiries about the alto saxophone and piano version of *Concerto*, Dorn order **202**.

changes.label: Score inquiries
changes.public_note: Contact [MATRIX](https://matrix-new-music.be/nl/publicaties/componistenfiches/de-jonghe-marcel/) for help locating the saxophone and piano score of *Concerto*, formerly listed by Lantro Music.

changes.label: Score inquiries
changes.public_note: Contact [To the Fore Publishers](https://www.totheforepublishers.com/order.php) for score inquiries about *Sonata* for soprano saxophone and piano.
